key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25386
name: walk_scene_command_stream
description: Subtracts an offset from three 16-bit coordinates and stores them, mirroring components selected by flag bits. It then walks a byte-coded command stream, recursing into nested streams and recording status bits in a shared flag byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:253A8
name: store_mirrored_point_then_walk
description: Stores three 16-bit values into a record at offsets chosen by a flag byte, negating components whose flag bits are set. It then walks the same byte-coded command stream, recursing into nested streams and recording status bits in a shared flag byte.

name: negate_and_swap_matrix_columns
description: Treats nine words at the register's address as a row-major 3x3 matrix. It negates the first column and swaps the second and third columns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:254BE
name: transpose_3x3_word_matrix
description: Transposes a 3x3 matrix of 16-bit words in place by exchanging each pair of off-diagonal entries. The diagonal entries are left unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:254CE
name: scale_and_multiply_coordinate_triples
description: Right-shifts a set of 32-bit values until they fall within a fixed limit, then multiplies coordinate triples by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and stores the 16-bit products. It also sets two flag bytes in the destination record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25528
name: scale_input_vector_and_transform
description: Shifts three input components right until their magnitude is within a fixed limit, then multiplies them by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and stores the products in a record. It then normalizes the stored triples and writes a second set of scaled results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:255B0
name: transform_and_renormalize_coordinates
description: Shifts three 32-bit inputs into a record and multiplies three coordinate triples by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix. It then renormalizes the products to a common scale set by their magnitudes, storing the shifted results and clearing two flag bytes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25794
name: scale_and_transform_matrix_block
description: Normalizes a 32-bit vector with right shifts, multiplies it by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix, and stores the results. It then copies nine words, clears a flag byte, and normalizes and multiplies a second vector by the same matrix.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:257EE
name: normalize_and_transform_stacked_vector
description: Shifts three components passed in registers and on the stack into a record, copies nine words, and clears a flag byte. It then normalizes a stored 32-bit vector and multiplies it by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix, storing the scaled results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2586A
name: normalize_and_transform_vector
description: Shifts three input components into a record, copies nine words within it, and clears a flag byte. It then normalizes a stored 32-bit vector and multiplies it by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix, storing the scaled results.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25946
name: stub_empty_placeholder
description: The routine contains only an immediate return, so calling it does nothing. It is an empty entry point with no state changes or I/O.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2598C
name: insert_sorted_list_node
description: Inserts a 12-byte record into a list ordered by a 16-bit key, taking the next record from a free pool when needed. It links the record into position and writes a status byte and three data words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25A08
name: insert_sorted_node_from_position
description: Walks a list ordered by a 16-bit key from a given starting record, then inserts a record at the matching position. It writes the key, a status byte and three data words into the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25A22
name: link_new_node_then_sort
description: Takes a new record from the free pool and links it after a given record, then walks the list to move it into key order. It writes a status byte and three data words into the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25A46
name: insert_or_update_list_node
description: Optionally takes a new record from the free pool and links it after a given record, copying a key into it. It then sets a status byte on the given record and writes three data words into the new record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25A7C
name: insert_sorted_node_from_cursor
description: Walks a list ordered by a 16-bit key from a cursor record, then inserts a record at the matching position. It writes the key, a status byte and three data words into the record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25ABE
name: set_node_key_and_data
description: Optionally links a record to its successor when the zero flag is set, then writes a 16-bit key and three data words into the record at the cursor.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25AD2
name: append_optional_list_node
description: If the zero flag is clear, it takes a record from the free pool, links it after a given record and sets its key. It then sets a status word and byte on the given record and writes three data words into the record at the cursor.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25B06
name: insert_or_update_keyed_node
description: Searches a list ordered by a 16-bit key for a given key. If the key's record is flagged it updates that record, otherwise it inserts a new record, writing a status byte, a link value and three data words; if no record matches, it marks the next flagged record found before a threshold key.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25B58
name: traverse_list_and_mark_node
description: Follows next links through a list from a cursor record until a record's key reaches a threshold. At the first flagged record it writes a status byte and a link value, then stops.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25B7C
name: insert_and_mark_key_range
description: Walks a list ordered by a 16-bit key and inserts a record for a given key when none exists, writing three data words into it. It then marks records in a following key range by writing a constant status word and a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25B9A
name: mark_key_range_records
description: Walks a key-ordered list from a starting record, inserting a record with a given key and three data words when none matches. It then sets a status word on records whose keys fall within a second range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25BEC
name: insert_node_and_mark_range
description: Inserts or reuses a record for a given key and writes three data words into it. It then sets a status byte on records in a key range and stops once the key passes the end of that range.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25C14
name: reset_list_node_flags
description: Optionally takes a record from the free pool and initializes it with a key. It then walks the list from a cursor and writes a constant status word into every record whose flag bit is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25C54
name: transform_vector_pair_with_matrix
description: Multiplies a short 3-component vector by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix pointed to in memory and stores the results. It then normalizes a set of 32-bit values by shifting them, multiplies them by the same matrix, and stores the shifted products.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25CFA
name: normalize_and_multiply_stacked_vector
description: Normalizes three inputs passed in registers and on the stack by right shifts, multiplies them by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix from memory, and stores the shifted results in a record.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25D78
name: store_shifted_register_values
description: Shifts three register values right by a variable count and stores them as 32-bit words. The other three values are stored as their sign portion, either 0 or -1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25D9E
name: multiply_stored_vectors_by_matrix
description: Multiplies a stored short 3-component vector by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix from memory and stores the result. It then normalizes a stored set of 32-bit values by right shifts, multiplies them by the same matrix, and writes the products to a second block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25E50
name: normalize_and_multiply_into_block
description: Normalizes three inputs passed in registers and on the stack by right shifts, multiplies them by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix from memory, and stores the shifted results in another record block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25EDA
name: store_shifted_register_block
description: Shifts three register values right by a variable count and stores them as 32-bit words. The other three values are stored as their sign portion, either 0 or -1.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25F00
name: multiply_record_vector_by_rows
description: Normalizes three 32-bit values from a record by right shifts. It returns the products of the first two rows of the 3x3 matrix stored at the start of that record with them, as a pair of 32-bit values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25F5A
name: return_normalized_row_products
description: Normalizes three inputs passed in registers and on the stack by right shifts. It returns the products of the first two rows of a 3x3 fixed-point matrix with them, as a pair of 32-bit values.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25FD6
name: return_shifted_pair
description: Shifts two register values right by the same variable count and returns them packed as a 64-bit pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:25FF6
name: advance_position_and_scan_flags
description: Adds a 64-bit step, scaled by a count, to a stored position and records the new position and transformed values. It then scans a table of flagged entries and handles the neighbours of matching ones.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26074
name: set_position_and_scan_flags
description: Stores a 64-bit position and direction values from registers, then adds a stepped offset from a record and stores the result. It then scans a table of flagged entries and handles matching neighbours.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26114
name: store_position_and_scan_neighbours
description: Stores six register values into the state block, then scans a table of flagged entries. It calls handlers that combine each matching neighbour's values with the stored ones.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26178
name: transform_flagged_entry_vertices
description: Walks a list of entries and, for entries whose status bits are set, multiplies their stored coordinate triples by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix. The results are saved in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26188
name: update_projected_positions
description: Checks status bits in the state block and, when they are set, transforms the stored coordinates through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix. It then adds a shifted scale of the stored offsets to the position block to produce a second set of positions.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2618C
name: scan_flagged_neighbours_loop
description: Scans a table of flagged entries from the highest index down. For each matching neighbour it stores transformed coordinates in the state block or calls a handler, and it updates status bytes as it goes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:261D0
name: combine_neighbour_positions
description: Scans neighbour records and, depending on their type codes, calls a handler with the sum or difference of the stored position and the neighbour's position. It sets a status byte after each pass.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26242
name: reset_status_and_scan_flags
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26266
name: set_status_from_record_flag
description: Sets a status byte from a flag in a record, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2627E
name: clear_status_and_scan_entries
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26290
name: adjust_neighbour_positions
description: Looks up each neighbour record by its type code and calls a handler with the stored position added to or subtracted from the neighbour's position. It then scans a table of flagged entries and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2631A
name: reset_status_then_scan_entries
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2633E
name: emit_zero_offset_and_scan
description: Calls a handler with a zero offset when the neighbour record is flagged, then clears a status byte. It then scans a table of flagged entries and updates the state block for matches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26384
name: clear_status_and_rescan_entries
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:263AC
name: negate_neighbour_position_and_scan
description: Calls a handler with a neighbour's negated position when the type codes match, otherwise clears a status byte. It then runs the same scan of flagged entries, transforming stored coordinate triples through a matrix and updating the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26420
name: clear_status_and_scan_flags
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26448
name: clear_status_and_scan_table
description: Clears a status byte, then scans a table of flagged entries. For matching neighbours it transforms stored coordinate triples through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and updates the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2647A
name: update_two_projected_position_sets
description: Transforms the stored coordinate triples through a matrix when flagged. It then writes two sets of shifted positions, each formed by adding a scaled offset to a base 64-bit position.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:264B8
name: transform_and_update_projected_positions
description: Multiplies a stored coordinate triple through a 3x3 matrix for flagged entries, then writes two sets of shifted positions formed by adding scaled offsets to base 64-bit positions. It returns the status byte from the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:264C4
name: return_halved_state_pair
description: Reads two 32-bit values from the state block, calls another routine, and returns a 64-bit pair. The pair holds the two values each halved by a one-bit right shift, together with the called routine's register outputs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26546
name: transform_vector_row_and_positions
description: Computes a dot product of a stored coordinate triple with the first row of a 3x3 fixed-point matrix and scales the result. It stores the outputs with the remaining rows in the state block, then writes two sets of shifted positions from scaled offsets.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:265F6
name: transform_3d_coordinates
description: Multiplies three input components by a 3x3 fixed-point matrix from a record and stores the result. It conditionally transforms a stored vector and writes two sets of shifted positions based on flag bits in the state block, then returns a status byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26786
name: select_closer_candidate
description: Checks a candidate record against a distance threshold and cross-product magnitude limits, returning early when it fails. Otherwise it computes a distance and, if it is less than the best distance so far, stores the candidate and its scaled coordinates in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:267D2
name: test_candidate_distance_and_store
description: Scales three register components down to a fixed range and checks cross-product magnitudes of a candidate against limits, returning early when they are exceeded. It then computes a distance and, if it is the smallest so far, records the candidate and its scaled coordinates in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26896
name: store_closer_candidate_record
description: Shifts the stored scaled coordinates by a count taken from the record. When the resulting distance is less than the best distance so far, it saves the candidate and its coordinates in the state block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:2692E
name: transform_record_and_store_candidate
description: Transforms the record's matrix-based coordinate triples and a second vector through a 3x3 fixed-point matrix. It then compares the record's distance value with the best so far and saves the record as the candidate if the distance is smaller.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26A58
name: interpret_render_command_list
description: Interprets a byte-coded command list. For sub-object commands it computes transformed coordinates into a stack buffer and emits entries into a table, while other command bytes branch to nested lists or skip ahead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26A92
name: resume_render_command_list
description: Resumes interpreting a byte-coded command list from a saved position when a flag is set. Sub-object commands compute transformed coordinates into a stack buffer and emit entries, then the remaining commands are processed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26A9C
name: continue_render_command_list
description: Continues interpreting a byte-coded command list from the current position. Sub-object commands compute transformed coordinates into a stack buffer and emit entries, while other command bytes branch to nested lists.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26AD2
name: stub_empty_placeholder
description: The routine contains only an immediate return, so calling it does nothing. It is an empty entry point with no state changes or I/O.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26AD4
name: scan_render_commands_loop
description: Loops over a byte-coded command list until a zero terminator. Sub-object commands compute transformed coordinates into a stack buffer and emit entries, while commands that test a state bit branch to nested lists or skip ahead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26AFC
name: process_render_command_flags
description: Processes byte-coded commands whose high bit marks a flagged command. Sub-object commands compute transformed coordinates into a stack buffer and emit entries, and the state bits of each command decide whether nested lists are followed.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)[cr][h black ninja][tr sp]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)[cr][h Black Ninja][tr Sp].adf:Frontier:5:26B22
